name: MUGEN ESTATE Co.,Ltd.
summary: MUGEN ESTATE Co.,Ltd. purchases and resells pre-owned properties in Japan. The company's property portfolio includes investment type properties, such as condominiums and office blocks and residential type properties, including detached houses for families. It engages in the development, leasing, and selling of real estate properties and interior and exterior construction business that includes renovate and refurbish stores, offices, office buildings, rental apartment complexes, and residential properties. The company was incorporated in 1990 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.
